Which expression represents the length of side $DE$?
explanation: Choice A is correct. In right triangle $DEF$ with the right angle at $E$, the side $DE$ is opposite the $64°$ angle at vertex $F$, and the hypotenuse $DF$ has length $18$. The sine of an angle in a right triangle is defined as the ratio of the length of the opposite side to the length of the hypotenuse: $\sin(64°) = \frac{DE}{18}$. Solving this equation for $DE$ by multiplying both sides by $18$ gives $DE = 18\sin(64°)$. Therefore, the expression $18\sin 64°$ correctly represents the length of side $DE$.
